models.name: Accordion-6B-A0.5B
models.tokens: 3.6T, plus 50B at 32K context, then SFT and RL

passes.range: loop_k 0, 3, 6, 9 or 12 (24-36 layer executions)

notes.en: Accordion is a 24-layer MoE (128 routed experts with top-8 routing plus one shared expert) trained from scratch and released at four stages: Base-8K after 3.6T tokens, Base-32K after 50B more tokens at 32K context, SFT on reasoning conversations with thinking traces, and RL, which the cards call the final model (three RL domain experts merged, then 10 steps of multi-teacher on-policy distillation). Looping repeats single layers in place: with budget k, the first k of layers 7-18 each run a second time right after their first pass, with the second pass scaled by a zero-initialised per-channel tanh gate and routed with a separate expert-selection bias. Training sampled k from {0, 3, 6, 9, 12} for each micro-batch, giving 24 to 36 layer executions per token; config.json sets loop_k 0, loop_generate takes loop_k per call and the SFT and RL card examples use loop_k 12, while other k values or layer sets (loop_layers_active) run but were never trained. Every layer execution keeps its own KV-cache slot, so at k = 12 the cache is 1.5 times its k = 0 size. In transformers the remote code must generate with loop_generate because model.generate() is not supported; vLLM serving needs vllm==0.24.0 plus the authors' accordion-vllm plugin and runs one budget per engine, set by LOOPMOE_K. The cards give ≈6.0B total and ≈0.54B active non-embedding parameters; the paper gives 6.03B and 0.54B (0.74B including the output head), and the safetensors total is 6,027,376,128. The cards set license: other without naming a license, while the GitHub code (Accordion-Loop) is Apache-2.0.
notes.zh: Accordion 是从头训练的 24 层 MoE（128 个路由专家取 top-8，另加 1 个共享专家），按四个阶段发布：3.6T token 后的 Base-8K，再用 50B token 在 32K 上下文继续训练的 Base-32K，在带思考轨迹的推理对话上 SFT 的版本，以及模型卡称为最终模型的 RL 版（三个 RL 领域专家合并后，再做 10 步多教师 on-policy 蒸馏）。循环方式是单层原地重复：预算为 k 时，第 7-18 层中的前 k 层在第一遍之后立即再跑一遍，第二遍输出乘以零初始化的逐通道 tanh 门控，路由时使用单独的专家选择 bias。训练时每个 micro-batch 从 {0, 3, 6, 9, 12} 中采样 k，对应每 token 24 到 36 次层计算；config.json 中 loop_k 为 0，loop_generate 每次调用可指定 loop_k，SFT 和 RL 模型卡的示例用 loop_k 12；其他 k 值或层组合（loop_layers_active）可以运行，但从未训练过。每次层计算各有一个 KV cache 槽位，k = 12 时缓存是 k = 0 时的 1.5 倍。在 transformers 中必须用远程代码里的 loop_generate 生成，不支持 model.generate()；vLLM 部署需要 vllm==0.24.0 加作者的 accordion-vllm 插件，每个引擎只跑一个预算，由 LOOPMOE_K 设定。模型卡给出约 6.0B 总参数和约 0.54B 激活非嵌入参数，论文给出 6.03B 和 0.54B（含输出头为 0.74B），safetensors 总数为 6,027,376,128。模型卡的 license 为 other，没有写明具体许可；GitHub 代码（Accordion-Loop）为 Apache-2.0。

models.name: ALoDLM

passes.range: 1-4 per denoising step, set by the exit gate and q

notes.en: Diffusion language models converted from Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-1.7B by direct supervised fine-tuning, with no continued pretraining, on a 5B-token corpus of math, code and instruction data in the WeDLM block-diffusion framework (eight epochs at 8B). ALoDLM-8B splits its 36 layers into a 10-layer prelude, a shared 16-layer recurrent core (layers 10-25) and a 10-layer coda, and ALoDLM-1.7B loops all 28 layers; both run at most four passes (alodlm_config.json max_depth 4). Decoding fills a 16-token window of mask tokens after the committed text; after each core pass the model reads out token predictions (through the coda at 8B) and a learned exit gate (exit_gate.pt) gives each unresolved token a halting probability. A token commits when its entropy plus a position penalty is below tau (in left1 mode, used for the paper's Table 1, the leftmost token commits each pass), committed tokens re-enter later passes as token embeddings, and the pass loop ends when the mean cumulative halting probability of the uncommitted tokens reaches q, when all tokens are committed, or after four passes. Recurrent layers keep a separate KV cache for each depth while prelude and coda layers keep one; prefill computes all four depths for the prompt, and depths that a window did not reach reuse the last computed depth. The models run only with the authors' code: the portable decoder alodlm-generate (PyTorch 2.8.0, transformers 4.56.1) or the bundled nano-vLLM/WeDLM engine alodlm-generate-optimized (PyTorch 2.10.0, transformers 5.5.4, vLLM 0.19.1 kernels); standard transformers generate() and vllm serve do not run the recurrent decoder or the exit gate. The weights are CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial), and the WeDLM-derived code in the repository keeps WeDLM's terms, which include a territorial restriction. Safetensors totals are 8,190,735,360 and 2,031,739,904 parameters, plus the exit gate in exit_gate.pt.
notes.zh: 由 Qwen3-8B 和 Qwen3-1.7B 转换而来的扩散语言模型：在 WeDLM block-diffusion 框架下直接 SFT，不做继续预训练，语料为 5B token 的数学、代码和指令数据（8B 训练八个 epoch）。ALoDLM-8B 把 36 层分为 10 层 prelude、16 层共享循环核心（第 10-25 层）和 10 层 coda，ALoDLM-1.7B 则循环全部 28 层；两者最多跑四遍（alodlm_config.json 中 max_depth 为 4）。解码时在已提交文本之后放一个 16 token 的 mask 窗口；每遍核心计算后读出 token 预测（8B 经过 coda），学习到的 exit gate（exit_gate.pt）给每个未确定 token 一个停止概率。熵加位置惩罚低于 tau 的 token 被提交（left1 模式下每遍提交最左边的一个 token，论文 Table 1 用的就是此模式），已提交 token 以 token 嵌入进入后续各遍；当未提交 token 的平均累计停止概率达到 q、全部 token 已提交或跑满四遍时，内循环结束。循环层为每个深度各存一份 KV，prelude 和 coda 层只存一份；prefill 为 prompt 计算全部四个深度，窗口未执行到的深度沿用最后一个已计算深度的 KV。只能用作者的代码运行：便携解码器 alodlm-generate（PyTorch 2.8.0、transformers 4.56.1），或自带的 nano-vLLM/WeDLM 引擎 alodlm-generate-optimized（PyTorch 2.10.0、transformers 5.5.4、vLLM 0.19.1 kernel）；标准 transformers generate() 和 vllm serve 不会运行循环解码器和 exit gate。权重采用 CC BY-NC 4.0（非商用），仓库中源自 WeDLM 的代码保留 WeDLM 的条款，其中含地域限制。safetensors 参数总数为 8,190,735,360 和 2,031,739,904，另有 exit_gate.pt 中的 exit gate。

models.name: ARLoop

passes.range: fixed (all three were trained with a fixed R = 3)

notes.en: ARLoop-1.2B and ARLoop-0.6B are base pretrained models (no instruction tuning) trained from scratch; all 24 (1.2B) or 18 (0.6B) physical layers run three times (config loop_count 3), giving 72 or 54 effective layers. Each sublayer reads an attention-weighted mix over depth of the input embedding and the three most recent residual blocks (attention residuals with a sliding window, sw_blocks 3), and every effective sublayer has its own learned query (attnres_queries), so the checkpoints fit loop_count 3 only. PreNormLoop-0.6B is the paper's baseline: the same 18-layer, three-loop model and 180B-token budget with standard PreNorm residuals and no attention residuals. Pretraining follows a SmolLM-style three-stage recipe on FineWeb-Edu, FineMath and Stack-Edu with more math, code and reasoning data in the later stages; intermediate checkpoints are available as step-XXXXXX revisions. The released modeling code stores a separate KV entry for every effective layer, i.e. one per loop. The cards load the models with trust_remote_code and pin transformers==5.12.1 (1.2B) or 5.22.0 (both 0.6B models); the GitHub repository also has a vLLM 0.25.1 plugin, used by its evaluation scripts, that accepts only the ARLoopForCausalLM releases. Safetensors totals are 1,208,655,360, 583,138,944 and 582,804,096 parameters (FP32), and the GitHub code is MIT-licensed.

models.name: Attractor

passes.range: min_iter, max_iter and tol; paper evaluates T = 0-8

notes.en: Language models pretrained on FineWeb-Edu. A causal Transformer backbone of 7 / 15 / 35 layers proposes an output embedding, and a weight-tied attractor head of 1 / 2 / 2 Transformer blocks is solved for a fixed point starting from that proposal, with the proposal added back at every step; the result is decoded with the tied unembedding. The loop is therefore a solver run: Anderson acceleration applies the head between min_iter and max_iter times and stops once the relative residual drops below tol, so the pass count varies with the input, and generate(num_steps=N) in the GitHub receval/models/attractor.py overrides max_iter. The repos hold a PyTorch state dict (model.pt), a config.json saved under the EQLM class name (an alias of Attractor in the code) and tokenizer.json; the cards' snippet only builds an untrained model from the named config, while attractor.from_pretrained(<repo>) or ModelingAttractor.from_pretrained(<repo>) from the GitHub package loads the weights. During generation only the backbone keeps a KV cache; the attractor head is re-run over the whole context for every new token, so nothing is cached per solver iteration. The paper reports that quality already peaks at T = 1 and that T = 0 (backbone only) is at or near the converged value (Figure 7). The 370M config.json sets min_iter 6 where paper Table 8 and the GitHub named config give 8, and the 770M config.json sets backward_type onestep where both give Anderson. The GitHub code is MIT-licensed, like the cards.
notes.zh: 在 FineWeb-Edu 上预训练的语言模型。因果 Transformer backbone（7 / 15 / 35 层）先给出输出嵌入，权重共享的 attractor head（1 / 2 / 2 个 Transformer block）以该提议为起点求解不动点，每一步都把提议加回输入，结果用共享的 unembedding 解码。因此这里的循环是一次求解：Anderson 加速在 min_iter 到 max_iter 次之间反复调用 head，相对残差低于 tol 即停止，遍数随输入变化；GitHub 中 receval/models/attractor.py 的 generate(num_steps=N) 可覆盖 max_iter。仓库里是 PyTorch state dict（model.pt）、以 EQLM 类名保存的 config.json（代码中 EQLM 是 Attractor 的别名）和 tokenizer.json；模型卡的示例代码只按命名配置构建未训练的模型，加载权重要用 GitHub 包中的 attractor.from_pretrained(<repo>) 或 ModelingAttractor.from_pretrained(<repo>)。生成时只有 backbone 保留 KV cache，attractor head 每生成一个 token 都要在完整上下文上重新运行，求解迭代不缓存任何 KV。论文报告质量在 T = 1 时已达峰值，T = 0（只用 backbone）也已达到或接近收敛值（Figure 7）。370M 的 config.json 把 min_iter 设为 6，而论文 Table 8 和 GitHub 命名配置为 8；770M 的 config.json 把 backward_type 设为 onestep，而两者都写 Anderson。GitHub 代码为 MIT license，与模型卡一致。

models.name: Concertina-2.27B

passes.range: fixed (fold_group 2 in config.json is built into the weights)

notes.en: Concertina-2.27B is a compressed student of Qwen/Qwen3-4B: every two adjacent teacher layers are folded into one shared block that runs twice, giving 18 unique blocks × 2 loop steps and the teacher's effective depth of 36. Each linear map of a block starts from the weight of the first layer of its pair; the second step adds a rank-64 correction initialized from the truncated SVD of the difference between the two layers and scaled per token by a gate, and each step keeps the RMSNorm weights of the layer it replaces. All parameters were then distilled from Qwen3-4B with forward KL plus 0.25 times cross-entropy on 22B tokens (35% math, 55% knowledge-oriented data, 10% general web text) in 1,024-token sequences. The loop count is fixed by the checkpoint's structure (fold_group 2 and fold_rank 64 in config.json), and the paper's N=3 fold of Qwen3-8B (3.68B) has no released checkpoint. Each loop step uses the KV-cache slot of the original layer it replaces, so the model keeps the teacher's 36 per-layer KV caches, and the GitHub self-test checks that cached and uncached generation match. Loading needs trust_remote_code; the card says it is tested with transformers 4.57 and 5.6, and versions older than 4.56 take torch_dtype instead of dtype. The card's example is plain greedy text completion and does not describe chat or thinking use; the paper's limitations note that folding keeps the teacher's forward FLOPs and KV cache.
notes.zh: Concertina-2.27B 是 Qwen/Qwen3-4B 的压缩学生模型：教师模型每两个相邻层折叠成一个跑两遍的共享块，得到 18 个独立块 × 2 个循环步，有效深度与教师相同，为 36 层。每个块的线性层从其所在层对中第一层的权重开始；第二步加一个 rank-64 修正，用两层权重之差的截断 SVD 初始化，并由逐 token 的门控缩放；每一步保留其所替代层的 RMSNorm 权重。之后全部参数从 Qwen3-4B 蒸馏，损失为前向 KL 加 0.25 倍交叉熵，共 22B token（35% 数学、55% 知识类数据、10% 通用网页文本），序列长度 1,024。循环次数由 checkpoint 的结构决定（config.json 中 fold_group 为 2，fold_rank 为 64）；论文中把 Qwen3-8B 按 N=3 折叠的模型（3.68B）没有发布 checkpoint。每个循环步使用其所替代原始层的 KV cache 槽位，因此模型保留教师的 36 层 KV cache，GitHub 自测会检查有无 cache 时生成结果一致。加载需要 trust_remote_code；模型卡说已在 transformers 4.57 和 5.6 上测试，4.56 之前的版本要用 torch_dtype 代替 dtype。模型卡的示例是贪心解码的纯文本续写，没有介绍对话或思考模式的用法；论文的局限性一节指出，折叠后前向 FLOPs 和 KV cache 与完整深度的教师相同。

models.name: Depth-Recurrent Transformer (S1)

passes.default: 8 (training mean; loops= is required per call)
passes.range: loops per call; paper evaluates 1-32, no gain beyond 8

notes.en: A single research checkpoint (S1, step 49209): a Llama-style model whose shape follows SmolLM2-135M, with 2 prelude blocks, a weight-tied core of 4 blocks and 2 coda blocks, trained with one seed on 12.9B FineWeb-Edu tokens with the SmolLM2 tokenizer. Following the Huginn recipe, the recurrent state starts from Gaussian noise, the prelude output is concatenated with the state and projected by a linear adapter on every loop, the core blocks use sandwich norms, and training sampled one loop count per step (log-normal around 8, at most 32) with backpropagation through the last 8 loops. The card gives 85.6M parameters (state dict, which lists the tied embedding and LM head matrices as two entries) and ~57.3M active per forward at r = 1; the paper gives 57.3M total and 29.0M unique non-embedding parameters (Table 1) and calls it a 135M-class model because its per-token compute at the training-mean depth is comparable to a 135M dense model. model.pt is a torch.save dict (config and state_dict) that loads with build_model from src/model.py in the GitHub repo, and the loop count is the required loops= argument of forward. The release has no generation helper and no KV cache: forward scores a whole sequence, and the paper's evaluation is teacher-forced and leaves KV caching for per-token exits untested. Because the state is drawn from noise on every call, outputs vary between calls unless the seed is fixed; the paper's allocation study switches to zero initialization for reproducible exits, and its training-free convergence exit (stop a token once its output distribution stops changing) is a post-hoc policy in bench/allocate.py, not part of forward.

models.name: DFM Mimir
models.tokens: 103B / ~70.5B per epoch (v1.5 / v1); total not stated

passes.range: L_cycles 1-5 degrade gracefully; H_cycles 1 or 3 break it (paper, v1)

notes.en: Danish and English chat models (Gemma 4 tokenizer and chat template) from Danish Foundation Models, trained from random initialization on instruction, reasoning, tool-use, multilingual and synthetic data without web-scale pretraining. v1 was trained on 161 datasets of about 70.5B tokens per epoch; v1.5 continues the v1 run on later mixtures, ending with DFM11 (103,214,604,702 sampled tokens per epoch), and is the EMA checkpoint at step 2,877,261. Both use the HRM-Text layout of two 16-layer stacks applied as LLLHLLLH (H_cycles 2, L_cycles 3); v1 backpropagates through the last five module applications and v1.5 through all eight, which is the only difference between the two config.json files (L_bp_cycles). In the paper's test-time sweep on v1, changing the number of L applications (1-5) degrades scores gracefully, while 1 or 3 H cycles break the model. The cards ask for a PrefixLM attention mask and, for v1.5, a transformers or vLLM build with native hrm_text support; the upstream transformers and vLLM implementations keep one KV slot per stack call. The official GGUF repos (BF16, Q8_0, Q4_K_M) need the DFM Mimir app or the schneiderkamplab llama.cpp fork; the GGUF cards make no claim of compatibility with stock llama.cpp or Ollama. The v1 card calls the model ~1B, the v1.5 card gives 1,786,775,040 total parameters (0.981B without the input embedding and output head) and the paper gives 1.78B; the v1 card lists 1,750,000 training steps, where the paper gives 1.65M steps for v1 and 1.2M further steps for v1.5. The schneiderkamplab FP8, AWQ-FP4 and FP4-MLX quantizations of v1 are not listed, since neither the model cards nor the paper present them as official releases.

models.name: Dory1.0-4B

passes.range: 1-4 (dory.num_loops in llama.cpp; n_recurrent_loops in vLLM)

notes.en: Looped normalized-GPT with interleaved sliding-window and full-attention layers, released by NVIDIA on October 16, 2026. The layer stack is split into input, recurrent and output groups; the shared recurrent block runs several times and the input is reinjected into every loop. Pre-trained on 6T tokens (NVFP4 for the first ~4.5T, BF16 for the rest), then extended to 256K context over 300B tokens; reasoning is always on in vLLM. The card recommends two loops, one loop to minimize compute and four when accuracy matters more. The default cache keeps a separate KV per loop; setting recurrent_kv_cache_mode to last_loop keeps one cache per recurrent attention layer. vLLM support is in vllm-project/vllm#60149 and llama.cpp support in ggml-org/llama.cpp#30306, so both currently need builds from those pull requests. NVFP4, MXFP8 and GGUF (Q5_K_M) versions are released next to the BF16 checkpoint.
notes.zh: NVIDIA 于 2026 年 10 月 16 日发布的循环 normalized-GPT，sliding-window 注意力层与全注意力层交替。层栈分为输入、循环、输出三组，共享的循环块重复运行，每一遍都重新注入输入。预训练 6T token（前约 4.5T 用 NVFP4，其余用 BF16），再用 300B token 把上下文扩到 256K；在 vLLM 中推理模式始终开启。模型卡推荐默认两遍循环，追求最小计算量时用一遍，更看重准确率时用四遍。默认缓存为每遍各存一份 KV；把 recurrent_kv_cache_mode 设为 last_loop 后，每个循环注意力层只保留一份缓存。vLLM 支持在 vllm-project/vllm#60149，llama.cpp 支持在 ggml-org/llama.cpp#30306，目前都需要从这两个 PR 构建。BF16 checkpoint 之外还发布了 NVFP4、MXFP8 和 GGUF（Q5_K_M）版本。

models.name: GRT (Gated Recurrent Transformer)

passes.default: 4, 4, 6, 6 (trained depth R; n is set per call)
passes.range: n up to the trained R; paper evaluates k = 0-4 / 0-6

notes.en: GRT is a nanoGPT-based prelude, shared core and coda model written p+n×R+c: at each of the R steps the state plus Gaussian noise is concatenated with the prelude output, projected back to the model width, run through the n shared blocks and blended into the residual stream by an elementwise sigmoid gate. All four were trained for 20,000 steps (~9.8B tokens) on common-pile/cccc_filtered with the GPT-2 tokenizer; in the paper, isoFLOP models run fewer unique blocks more times to match a dense GPT-2 model's forward FLOPs, and isoParam models keep the dense model's number of unique blocks and spend more FLOPs (Table 1). The two medium repos appear swapped: grt-medium-isoparam holds the 2+5×4+2 model (config.json n_layer 5, card val loss 2.8956) that the paper and the GitHub configs call isoFLOP, and grt-medium-isoflop holds the 2+20×4+2 isoParam model (n_layer 20, 2.7632); their cards' Regime rows, the GitHub README table and the HF collection follow the repo names. params uses the cards' values; paper Table 1 gives 127M for 2+5×4+2, 357M for 2+20×4+2, 779M for 3+30×6+3 and 293M for 1+5×6+5. The cards load ckpt.pt with model.py from the GitHub repo; the loop count is n in model.generate(..., n=...) or sample.py --recurrent_depth, GPT.forward runs one recurrence when n is not given, and the GitHub README says any value up to the trained R (4 medium, 6 large) can be used, although the cards' example passes n=6 to all four. model.py has no KV cache, so generate() re-runs the whole context through every recurrence for each new token; the paper describes one KV cache per recurrence step as the naive decoding setup and also tests reusing only the first or last step's cache or averaging K/V across steps (Figure 7, Table 4). model.py adds the state and gate noise (noise_std 0.1) on every forward call, including eval mode, although its comment says training only. The GitHub repository has no LICENSE file; the cards say cc-by-4.0.
notes.zh: GRT 基于 nanoGPT，结构为 prelude、共享核心和 coda，记作 p+n×R+c：R 步中的每一步把状态加上高斯噪声后与 prelude 输出拼接，投影回模型宽度，经过 n 个共享 block，再由逐元素 sigmoid 门控混入残差流。四个模型都在 common-pile/cccc_filtered 上用 GPT-2 tokenizer 训练了 20,000 步（约 9.8B token）；按论文 Table 1，isoFLOP 模型用更少的唯一 block 重复更多次，以匹配 dense GPT-2 模型的前向 FLOPs，isoParam 模型保持与 dense 模型相同的唯一 block 数，代价是更多 FLOPs。两个 medium 仓库看起来装反了：grt-medium-isoparam 里是论文和 GitHub 配置称为 isoFLOP 的 2+5×4+2 模型（config.json 中 n_layer 为 5，模型卡 val loss 2.8956），grt-medium-isoflop 里是 isoParam 的 2+20×4+2 模型（n_layer 为 20，2.7632）；它们模型卡中的 Regime 一栏、GitHub README 表格和 HF collection 都按仓库名描述。params 用的是模型卡的数值；论文 Table 1 给出 2+5×4+2 为 127M、2+20×4+2 为 357M、3+30×6+3 为 779M、1+5×6+5 为 293M。模型卡用 GitHub 仓库的 model.py 加载 ckpt.pt；循环次数由 model.generate(..., n=...) 或 sample.py --recurrent_depth 的 n 设定，不传 n 时 GPT.forward 只跑一步循环；GitHub README 说可以用不超过训练时 R 的任意值（medium 为 4，large 为 6），但模型卡示例对四个模型都传 n=6。model.py 没有 KV cache，generate() 每生成一个 token 都要把完整上下文重新跑过每一步循环；论文把每个循环步各存一份 KV cache 描述为朴素的解码方式，并测试了只复用首步或末步的 cache 以及跨步平均 K/V（Figure 7，Table 4）。model.py 在每次前向中都加入状态噪声和门控噪声（noise_std 为 0.1），eval 模式也不例外，尽管代码注释说只在训练时使用。GitHub 仓库没有 LICENSE 文件；模型卡写的是 cc-by-4.0。

models.name: Foil (How to Loop MoE)

passes.range: fixed (num_stacks is built into the weights)

notes.en: The paper's four main looped MoE language models, one per folder, each with 553.7M parameters, hidden size 1024, 16 attention heads and top-2 routing, trained on 100B FineWeb-Edu (sample-100BT) tokens with the SmolLM2 tokenizer. Each has one MoE layer with 8 experts before the loop and one after it, around a looped block of D layers run L times, 18 executed layers in all: Foil-1 has 64 experts per layer, 1 layer and 16 passes, Foil-2 32, 2 and 8, Foil-3 16, 4 and 4, and Base 8, 8 and 2. All four folders are looped variants: the experts and routers are shared across passes while every pass has its own attention weights, and Base is the unflattened looped baseline; the paper's tied-attention controls (Base-tied, proto-Foil) are not in this repo, and the paper has no non-looped control at equal parameters and compute (Appendix J). Flattening halves the layers, doubles the experts per layer and doubles the passes, so expert parameters and expert calls per token stay fixed; the card says the released weights are the final step (254,313) of each run. Load a folder with AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(repo, subfolder=..., trust_remote_code=True); the card warns that labels are not shifted inside the model, that the returned loss includes the router auxiliary losses, and that attention masks with padding are refused, so batched generation with left padding does not work. The pass count is fixed by num_stacks in config.json, which also sets how many per-pass attention sets are stored. The modeling code has no KV cache: it turns use_cache off and recomputes the whole prefix at every generation step. Intermediate checkpoints are in ShourenWSR/loopmoe-U4_100B, -U3_100B, -U2_100B and -U1_100B (Foil-1, Foil-2, Foil-3, Base).
notes.zh: 论文的四个主要循环 MoE 语言模型，每个目录一个，均为 553.7M 参数、hidden size 1024、16 个注意力头、top-2 路由，用 SmolLM2 tokenizer 在 100B FineWeb-Edu（sample-100BT）token 上训练。每个模型在循环前后各有一个 8 专家的 MoE 层，中间是由 D 层组成、跑 L 遍的循环块，展开后共执行 18 层：Foil-1 每层 64 个专家、1 层、16 遍，Foil-2 为 32、2、8，Foil-3 为 16、4、4，Base 为 8、8、2。四个目录都是循环模型：专家和路由器在各遍之间共享，每一遍有自己的注意力权重，Base 是未展平的循环基线；论文中共享注意力的对照模型（Base-tied、proto-Foil）不在这个仓库里，论文也没有等参数、等计算量的不循环对照（Appendix J）。展平把层数减半、每层专家数加倍、遍数加倍，因此专家参数和每 token 的专家调用次数保持不变；模型卡说发布的权重是每次训练的最后一步（254,313）。用 AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(repo, subfolder=..., trust_remote_code=True) 加载某个目录；模型卡提醒，模型内部不对 labels 做移位，返回的 loss 包含路由辅助损失，含 padding 的 attention mask 会被拒绝，因此不支持左填充的批量生成。遍数由 config.json 的 num_stacks 固定，它同时决定存储多少套逐遍注意力参数。建模代码没有 KV cache：它关闭 use_cache，每个生成步都重新计算整个前缀。各次训练的中间 checkpoint 在 ShourenWSR/loopmoe-U4_100B、-U3_100B、-U2_100B 和 -U1_100B（对应 Foil-1、Foil-2、Foil-3、Base）。

models.name: HRM-Text-1B

passes.range: fixed (no other setting documented)

notes.en: Pre-alignment base checkpoint from Sapient Intelligence, trained from scratch with a response-only task-completion loss on instruction-response pairs and a PrefixLM mask; it is not instruction-tuned or chat-aligned, is English only and was not trained on code. Two separate 16-layer Transformer stacks, a fast L module and a slow H module, work on the same input embeddings with additive state injection: each of the H_cycles = 2 outer cycles runs the L module L_cycles = 3 times and then the H module once. Training sampled 40B unique tokens from a 176.5B-token open-source corpus for 60B training tokens in total; gradients first flow through the last two recurrent steps and later through the last five, and the released weights are the EMA checkpoint. The model type hrm_text is native in transformers>=5.9.0, and the card asks for token_type_ids that mark the prompt as one bidirectional prefix block, since attention otherwise falls back to causal. The transformers code gives every stack call its own KV-cache slots (num_layers_per_stack × H_cycles × (L_cycles + 1) in total); vLLM added HrmTextForCausalLM in v0.24.0 (vllm-project/vllm#43098) with one KV slot per recurrence step, while the GitHub README still lists vLLM support as in progress. The safetensors count is 1,182,795,264 parameters (BF16).
notes.zh: Sapient Intelligence 发布的预对齐（pre-alignment）基座 checkpoint，从头训练，在指令-回复对上只对回复计算 task-completion 损失，并使用 PrefixLM mask；未做指令微调或对话对齐，只支持英文，也没有用代码数据训练。两个独立的 16 层 Transformer 栈（快速的 L 模块和慢速的 H 模块）作用于同一份输入嵌入，状态以加法注入：H_cycles = 2 个外层循环中，每个先运行 L 模块 L_cycles = 3 次，再运行 H 模块一次。训练从 176.5B token 的开源语料中采样 40B 个不重复 token，总训练量 60B token；梯度起初只反传最后两个循环步，之后扩展到最后五步，发布的权重是 EMA checkpoint。模型类型 hrm_text 在 transformers>=5.9.0 中原生支持；模型卡要求传入 token_type_ids，把整个 prompt 标为一个双向 prefix 块，否则注意力会退回纯因果。transformers 代码为每次栈调用分配独立的 KV cache 槽位（共 num_layers_per_stack × H_cycles × (L_cycles + 1) 个）；vLLM 在 v0.24.0 加入 HrmTextForCausalLM（vllm-project/vllm#43098），每个循环步各占一个 KV 槽位，而 GitHub README 仍写着 vLLM 支持在开发中。safetensors 统计为 1,182,795,264 个参数（BF16）。

models.name: Intern-S2-Mobius
models.tokens: 1TB tokens of continued pre-training (paper wording), then SFT and RL

passes.default: 10 (40 layers share 4 routed-expert pools; layer i uses pool i mod 4)
passes.range: fixed (num_blocks 4)

notes.en: Multimodal model (image-text-to-text) converted from Qwen3.5-35B-A3B to the Mobius-v0 architecture, continued pre-trained on 1TB tokens (the paper's wording) and post-trained with SFT and RL. In the released code the 40 decoder layers (in each group of four, three Gated DeltaNet linear-attention layers and one full-attention layer) each run once and keep their own attention weights, while their routed experts come from num_blocks = 4 shared meta-MoE blocks: layer i uses block i mod 4, so the router and 2,560 experts of each block (8 active per token) are queried by 10 layers for every token, and each layer adds its own small gated shared expert. The paper calls the shared expert pool Memory and the attention layers Reasoners, and describes Mobius-v0 as one global FFN memory shared by all layers; its from-scratch 7B-A1B model is not released. The card's Dynamic Latent Reasoning (recurrent latent iteration before decoding) has no separate iteration setting in the released code: generating a token is one pass through the 40 layers, plus an optional MTP head that the card recommends for speculative decoding. The cache keeps one slot per layer, KV for the 10 full-attention layers and conv and recurrent states for the 30 linear-attention layers. The card documents LMDeploy (PyTorch backend, InternLM's own engine, listed here as custom code), transformers with trust_remote_code and vLLM builds with Intern-S2-Mobius support. Intern-S2-Mobius-FP8 is the official FP8 version. The safetensors total is 35,964,405,616 parameters, including the 27-layer vision encoder.

models.name: IQuest-Coder-V1-40B-Loop

passes.range: fixed (loop_num)

notes.en: IQuest-Coder-V1-40B-Loop-Instruct and -Loop-Thinking are dense 40B code models (80 layers, hidden size 5120, 40 query and 8 KV heads, 76,800-token vocabulary) that run the whole layer stack twice with shared parameters (loop_num 2). In the second iteration each attention layer mixes global attention over the first iteration's keys and values with local attention over the second iteration's own recent keys and values, weighted per head by a sigmoid gate computed from the query. The released cache keeps the full first-iteration KV plus only the last loop_window_size tokens of second-iteration KV; loop_window_size is 64 in the Loop-Instruct config and 8192 in the Loop-Thinking config. The report's text mentions position-shifted hidden states in the first iteration but also says the token shifting of Parallel Loop Transformer is omitted, and the released code passes the first iteration's output straight into the second. The loop models follow the same pre-training, 32K and 128K mid-training, and SFT plus RL pipeline as the dense models; the LoopCoder PDF in the GitHub repo adds that the loop was initialized by folding a pre-trained dense checkpoint, gives 12T+ pre-training tokens and calls the model 40B-A80B, although its Table 1 also lists 80B activated parameters for the dense 40B models. The Loop-Thinking card calls that model a research-oriented experimental prototype that is not intended to reach state-of-the-art benchmark results. Both repos load with trust_remote_code (the Loop-Instruct card recommends transformers==4.56.0, the Loop-Thinking card transformers>=4.52.4), vLLM support came with vllm-project/vllm#31575 (merged January 2026), and IQuestLab has published no quantized Loop checkpoints. HF lists the license as other with the name iquestcoder; the Loop-Instruct card links the Modified MIT License of IQuest-Coder-V1-40B-Instruct, which asks commercial products to display "IQuest Coder", while the LICENSE file in the Loop-Thinking repo is empty.

models.name: LatentLoop

passes.default: 2 (middle layers visited twice, the first visit on a 2x compressed sequence)
passes.range: fixed

notes.en: Base MoE language models for text continuation at three sizes, one per subfolder (1.3B-40B, 3B-70B, 7B-140B, named by reference token budget), trained from scratch on FineWeb-Edu sample350BT with the 32K TinyLlama tokenizer; no instruction tuning or chat template. The 12 / 16 / 20 stored layers form entry, middle and exit blocks of a quarter, a half and a quarter of the layers, and the middle block is visited twice, giving 18 / 24 / 30 executed layers. The visits are asymmetric: the first runs on a latent sequence in which each pair of adjacent token states is averaged, and its increment is rescaled by two learned per-channel vectors and written back to the last token of the pair and to the next token, so an update only reaches positions after its whole source pair; the second visit runs on the full sequence. Only the MoE routers and experts are shared between the visits and each visit has its own attention parameters; width, attention dimensions, stored experts (75 / 75 / 76 per layer, 8 active) and training steps were set so that stored parameters, KV cache, FLOPs per step and training FLOPs stay within 1% of an MoE baseline and an ordinary looped MoE. inference.py (also in the GitHub code) loads one subfolder with load_pretrained(..., subfolder=...), keeps the FP32 weights and uses BF16 autocast on CUDA; its generate() is greedy with batch size one. The loader keeps one KV cache per layer execution, so the two visits never share K/V even where weights are shared; the first visit's cache covers the compressed sequence, and an unfinished token pair and the last writeback update are held in small buffers during decoding. The visit count is fixed at two. The params column gives the card's size labels; each subfolder's training_summary.json gives 1,299,003,368 / 3,194,972,016 / 6,858,742,008 parameters, matching paper Table 6.
notes.zh: 三个规模的 MoE 基座语言模型，用于文本续写，每个子目录一个（1.3B-40B、3B-70B、7B-140B，以参考 token 预算命名），在 FineWeb-Edu sample350BT 上用 32K TinyLlama tokenizer 从头训练，没有指令微调，也没有 chat template。12 / 16 / 20 个存储层分为入口、中间和出口三段，分别占层数的四分之一、二分之一和四分之一，中间段访问两次，执行层数为 18 / 24 / 30。两次访问不对称：第一次在潜在序列上运行，该序列把相邻两个 token 的状态取平均，其增量经两组可学习的逐通道系数缩放后，写回该 token 对的最后一个 token 和下一个 token，因此更新只会到达整个源 token 对之后的位置；第二次访问在完整序列上运行。两次访问之间只共享 MoE 的路由器和专家，每次访问有自己的注意力参数；宽度、注意力维度、每层存储的专家数（75 / 75 / 76，激活 8 个）和训练步数都经过调整，使存储参数、KV cache、每步 FLOPs 和训练 FLOPs 与 MoE 基线及普通循环 MoE 的差距都在 1% 以内。仓库中的 inference.py（GitHub 代码中也有）用 load_pretrained(..., subfolder=...) 加载一个子目录，保留 FP32 权重，在 CUDA 上用 BF16 autocast；其 generate() 是 batch size 为 1 的贪心解码。加载器为每次层执行各存一份 KV cache，所以即使权重共享，两次访问也不共用 K/V；第一次访问的 cache 覆盖压缩后的序列，解码时未凑齐的 token 对和最近一次写回的更新保存在小缓冲区中。访问次数固定为两次。params 列是模型卡的规模标签；各子目录 training_summary.json 给出的参数量为 1,299,003,368 / 3,194,972,016 / 6,858,742,008，与论文 Table 6 一致。

models.name: LoopCoder-V2

passes.range: fixed (the paper trains each loop count separately)

notes.en: Instruction-tuned 7B dense code model based on the Parallel Loop Transformer (PLT), trained from scratch on 18T tokens of text and code (1:1, more than 100 programming languages) and then fine-tuned on 6M instruction examples. Its 14 shared layers run twice (plt_num_loops 2); the paper trained separate models at 1, 2, 3 and 4 loops, each evaluated at its training loop count, and only the two-loop instruction model is released. Before the second loop, the first loop's hidden states are shifted right by one token and added to the token embeddings (cross-loop position offset), so loops of neighbouring tokens can run concurrently in one forward pass. In the second loop each attention layer mixes, through a per-head gate, full attention over the first loop's KV cache with 64-token sliding-window attention over the second loop's own keys and values, so only the first loop keeps a full-length cache. The HF repository has configuration and tokenizer code but no modeling file, and its auto_map lists only AutoConfig, although the GitHub README shows a transformers snippet with trust_remote_code. The card's inference path is the vLLM build at yxing-bj/vllm, which adds IQuestPLTCoderForCausalLM, used with transformers==4.57.1 and the --trust-remote-code flag. The safetensors total is 7,615,749,680 parameters; the card says approximately 7B.

models.name: Looped GPT-BERT 4x12

passes.range: fixed (trained at 12)

models.license: not stated on the model card

notes.en: English base model trained from scratch for the BabyLM 2026 Strict-Small track with GPT-BERT's hybrid objective (25% masked next-token prediction, 75% causal language modelling) on one shared backbone and a tied output head. Four physical Transformer layers (hidden size 384, 6 heads) run 12 times: the recurrent state starts at zero, is added to the static token embeddings at the start of every loop, and the logits come from the state after loop 12, giving 48 layer applications. Each physical layer has a Dense Weighted Average (DWA) residual mixer whose accumulator restarts in that layer on every loop (dwa_scope physical_layer). Training used an 8,192-token byte-level BPE tokenizer trained on the corpus, 128-token sequences and 10 epochs (4,220 optimizer steps) over 7,482,193 words, about 74.82M word exposures; checkpoints at the BabyLM word milestones are the revisions chck_1M to chck_70M. The same weights load as AutoModelForCausalLM or AutoModelForMaskedLM with trust_remote_code. The modeling code has no KV cache, so generation feeds the full prefix back at every step. The card gives no license.

models.name: Looped UDLM (OpenWebText)
models.tokens: about 0.5T for the baseline; looped runs stop at matched training FLOPs

passes.default: set per evaluation run: a fixed S or adaptive (cap 12)
passes.range: S 1-12 in training; any S at test time (card example: 24)

notes.en: Uniform-state discrete diffusion language models (DUO++ denoisers with 12 blocks, width 768, the GPT-2 tokenizer and 1,024-token sequences) trained on OpenWebText and released as three PyTorch Lightning checkpoints that hold the model, EMA (decay 0.9999) and optimizer states: the non-looped baseline (S = 1, 1,000,000 steps), a looped model trained with S drawn uniformly from 1-12 (mean 6.5, 655,420 steps) and one trained with p(S) proportional to 1/F(S) (mean 5.72, 688,915 steps). The looped models share the weights of blocks 1-2 and replay them S times in every denoiser call, so a call executes 12 + 2(S-1) blocks; each looped run stops at the step whose training FLOPs match the baseline's 1M steps, and the paper describes the baseline as trained on about 0.5 trillion tokens. The evaluation scripts in the GitHub code take a depth policy for every run: baseline, an integer S (any value, including beyond the training range, such as 24), or adaptive, where a sequence stops at the first traversal whose relative hidden-state change is below 0.1, capped at 12 traversals. The paper's FineWeb-Edu runs are not in this repository. Each denoiser call predicts every position of the sequence, so there is no autoregressive KV cache.

models.name: LoopFormer

passes.range: any budget M up to L via steps; paper evaluates M = 2, 4, 8

notes.en: LoopFormer loops a stack of k Transformer blocks (3 or 2 here; width 2048, 32 heads) that makes up the whole model between the embeddings and the LM head. Each loop is conditioned on the normalized time t and the step size Δt through adaLN-style scales and residual gates, and training adds a sampled shorter trajectory with a shortcut-consistency loss so that fewer loops still give usable outputs. Per the paper, the 3⊗8 and 2⊗12 models were trained for 50,000 steps on a deduplicated subset of The Pile (about 25B tokens), and the repos ship a GPT-2 tokenizer; the -FineWeb300K repo is not described in the paper or the GitHub README, so its data and token count are not stated. The repos have no model card; config.json maps AutoModelForCausalLM to modeling_loopformer.LoopFormerGPTForCausalLM, so they load with trust_remote_code=True, and GPT.from_pretrained in the GitHub models/loopformer.py loads them the same way. The loop count is the length of the steps list passed to forward or generate (step sizes summing to 1, for example steps=[0.25]*4 for four loops; the paper's main results use uniform steps 1/M); without it the 3-block models run 8 equal steps and the 2-block model 12. modeling_loopformer.py has no KV cache: every forward pass recomputes the whole sequence through all loops. armenjeddi/NanoGPT-Base24-FineWeb300K in the same collection is the non-looped 24-layer baseline and is not listed. The GitHub code is an MIT-licensed nanoGPT fork.
notes.zh: LoopFormer 把 k 个 Transformer block（此处为 3 或 2 个；宽度 2048，32 个 head）组成的堆栈反复循环，这个堆栈就是 embedding 与 LM head 之间的全部模型。每一遍以归一化时间 t 和步长 Δt 为条件，通过 adaLN 式的缩放和残差门控调制；训练时还额外采样一条更短的轨迹并加 shortcut-consistency 损失，使少跑几遍也能得到可用的输出。按论文，3⊗8 和 2⊗12 模型在去重后的 The Pile 子集上训练了 50,000 步（约 25B token），仓库附带 GPT-2 tokenizer；-FineWeb300K 仓库在论文和 GitHub README 中都没有描述，其数据和 token 数未说明。这些仓库没有模型卡；config.json 把 AutoModelForCausalLM 映射到 modeling_loopformer.LoopFormerGPTForCausalLM，因此要用 trust_remote_code=True 加载，GitHub 中 models/loopformer.py 的 GPT.from_pretrained 也是这样加载。循环次数就是传给 forward 或 generate 的 steps 列表长度（各步长之和为 1，例如 steps=[0.25]*4 表示四遍；论文主要结果用均匀步长 1/M）；不传时 3-block 模型跑 8 个等长步，2-block 模型跑 12 个。modeling_loopformer.py 没有 KV cache：每次前向都把整个序列重新跑过所有循环。同一 collection 里的 armenjeddi/NanoGPT-Base24-FineWeb300K 是不循环的 24 层基线，未列出。GitHub 代码是采用 MIT license 的 nanoGPT fork。

models.name: LoopUS
models.tokens: 3B (FineWeb-Edu) each; the SFT repo adds UltraChat 200k

passes.default: up to 20 (config N; 100 for the 4B), confidence exit
passes.range: --n-recursion (scripts default to 8; the paper uses 8)

notes.en: LoopUS post-trains a pretrained LLM into an encoder (first layers), a looped reasoning block (the middle layers) and a decoder (last layer); only the reasoning block repeats, a selective gate mixes each pass's output with the previous state, and a confidence head can stop the loop early. The layer splits in config.json are encoder 0-1 and decoder 27 for Qwen3-1.7B, 0-1 and 35 for Qwen3-4B, 0-7 and 35 for Qwen3-8B (the paper lists encoder layers 0-5), 0-5 and 39 for Phi-4, and 0 and 21 for TinyLlama. The paper trains each model on 3B FineWeb-Edu tokens at context 1024 with 20 loop steps per batch, of which 5 sampled depths receive gradients; Qwen3_1.7B_LoopUS_SFT is the 1.7B model fine-tuned on UltraChat 200k for one epoch, which the GitHub README says does not work perfectly yet. The cards name Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B-Base, Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base as base models, while config.json (base_model_name_or_path) and the paper use Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B; the other bases are microsoft/phi-4 and TinyLlama/TinyLlama_v1.1. config.json sets the loop budget N (20, or 100 for the 4B) and q_threshold 0.9, but chat.py, generate.py and LoopUS-eval override N with --n-recursion (default 8), and chat.py also sets the threshold to 0.6, the value the paper uses for standard inference. modeling_lds.py keeps separate KV caches for the encoder, the decoder and each recursion depth; after an early exit only the caches of the depths that ran are passed to the next decoding step, so deeper depths start again from an empty cache. Loading needs the GitHub code (LDSForCausalLM, model_type lds, transformers>=5.0.0); the 4B and Phi-4 cards' example commands point to Qwen3_1.7B_LoopUS_SFT, and the 8B card uses the non-existent name Thrillcrazyer/Qwen3_8B_LoopUS. Other lds-type repos under the account, such as the LoopUS_Qwen3-1.7B_Ver2 series and LoopUS_EXAONE-4.0-1.2B, have no model card and no link from the paper, the project page or the GitHub repo, and are not listed.

models.name: LoopVL-1B

passes.range: H_cycles and L_cycles; paper tests 12 schedules

models.license: not stated on the card (repo includes LICENSE-Penguin.txt)

notes.en: LoopVL-1B is an image-text-to-text model: a frozen Penguin-VL vision encoder and a two-layer projector feed a recurrent language backbone that the authors pretrained from scratch with the HRM-Text framework and data, not HRM-Text's released checkpoint. The backbone has two 16-layer stacks, L and H, with separate weights; the default H2L3 schedule runs L three times and then H, twice (L→L→L→H→L→L→L→H), for 128 layer applications per forward pass, and at the start of each cycle a gated visual anchor from the projected image embeddings is added back into the H state. Training used 75B text pretraining tokens, 0.33B for visual alignment, 49B for multimodal mid-training, 16.81B for SFT and 0.006B for GRPO RL, listed as 0.14T in paper Tables 1 and 2. H_cycles and L_cycles in config.json set the schedule; paper Table 4 tested 12 inference schedules on this checkpoint, and H2L3, the training schedule, scored best on all five benchmarks. The released runtime keeps no KV cache: greedy_generate recomputes the whole recurrent sequence for every new token with use_cache=False. The Hub repo holds only weights and configuration; inference needs the custom loader in the GitHub runtime/ directory with transformers 5.15.1 (not AutoModel or vLLM), the mixed BF16/FP32 weights must not be cast to one dtype, and the card recommends direct answers except on math. The model card states no license and the HF API has no license field; the repo ships LICENSE-Penguin.txt, Tencent's license terms for Penguin-VL, whose clause 0 says Penguin-VL is not intended for use within the European Union, while the GitHub code is Apache-2.0 and its THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md says relocating the Penguin notice does not assign a new license to the model weights. The paper names the model LoopVL-1B, and the safetensors file, which includes the vision encoder, holds 1,628,587,779 parameters (HF API).
notes.zh: LoopVL-1B 是图文到文本的模型：冻结的 Penguin-VL 视觉编码器和两层 projector 把图像特征送入循环语言骨干，该骨干由作者用 HRM-Text 的开源框架和数据从头预训练，没有使用 HRM-Text 发布的 checkpoint。骨干包含 L 和 H 两个 16 层的层栈，权重互不共享；默认的 H2L3 调度先跑三遍 L 再跑一遍 H，共两轮（L→L→L→H→L→L→L→H），每次前向执行 128 次层计算，每轮开始时把来自投影后图像 embedding 的门控视觉锚点重新加回 H 状态。训练用了 75B token 的文本预训练、0.33B 的视觉对齐、49B 的多模态 mid-training、16.81B 的 SFT 和 0.006B 的 GRPO RL，论文 Table 1 和 Table 2 记为 0.14T。config.json 中的 H_cycles 和 L_cycles 决定调度；论文 Table 4 在这个 checkpoint 上测试了 12 种推理调度，与训练一致的 H2L3 在全部五个基准上得分最高。发布的推理代码不使用 KV cache：greedy_generate 每生成一个 token 都以 use_cache=False 重算整个循环序列。Hub 仓库只有权重和配置；推理需要 GitHub 仓库 runtime/ 目录中的自带加载器和 transformers 5.15.1（不能用 AutoModel 或 vLLM），BF16/FP32 混合精度的权重不能整体转成一种 dtype，模型卡建议除数学题外直接作答。模型卡没有写 license，HF API 也没有 license 字段；仓库附带 LICENSE-Penguin.txt，即腾讯的 Penguin-VL 许可条款，其第 0 条写明 Penguin-VL 不打算在欧盟境内使用；GitHub 代码为 Apache-2.0，其 THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md 说迁移 Penguin 的声明不会给模型权重赋予新的 license。论文称该模型为 LoopVL-1B，包含视觉编码器的 safetensors 文件共有 1,628,587,779 个参数（HF API）。

passes.range: fixed (paper Section 3: exactly two passes in training and inference)

notes.en: Logos is the larger of the two Metis-1.6 models, built from scratch by Lernex: Metis-1.6-Logos-Base is the pretrained base and Metis-1.6-Logos the post-trained reasoning model, which thinks by default and answers directly with enable_thinking=False. Its 20 layers are Mamba-2 except for attention without positional encoding at layers 5, 10 and 15, and each ends in a latent MoE with 192 routed experts (4 per token) and one shared expert; the whole stack runs twice per token with shared weights, a depth memory lets pass 2 read what pass 1 wrote, and each attention layer adds a pass-indexed rank-8 update to its QKV projection. Pretraining used 804.76B tokens and context extension 17.94B tokens (4,096 to 131,072), followed by 120.00B tokens of cold-start SFT and 80.00B of overall SFT; the card says RL was also run but shortened the reasoning at the cost of breadth, so the release is the end of SFT. config.json sets num_passes 2 (max_passes 5), and the paper says every token takes exactly two passes in training and inference; the halting head left in the checkpoint does not affect the released model. modeling_metis16.py keeps one decode state per (layer, pass), 34 Mamba states and 6 key/value caches for Logos: the 3 attention layers store separate keys and values for each pass and each Mamba-2 layer keeps a separate conv and SSM state for each pass, so nothing is shared between passes and the cache cannot be cropped. The BF16 repos load in Transformers 4.57 or newer with trust_remote_code, in vLLM 0.31 through the vllm-metis plugin, in SGLang 0.5.22 or newer through sglang-metis, and in the authors' Dromos engine; FP8 runs in Dromos, vLLM and SGLang, NVFP4 only in Dromos, the GGUF files in llama.cpp b12089 or newer, and the MLX builds in mlx-lm with trust_remote_code. The Base card says the vLLM, SGLang and llama.cpp paths were validated on the post-trained weights, and a 1.77B-parameter hashed n-gram memory used in pretraining was removed before release because the model had closed its gates.

models.name: Nanbeige4.2-3B

passes.range: fixed; Section 2.1 chose two passes from pretraining experiments

notes.en: Nanbeige4.2-3B-Base is pretrained from scratch on 28T tokens; Nanbeige4.2-3B is the post-trained agentic and reasoning model built on it (SFT in 64K, 128K and 256K context stages, then RLHF over think and non-think responses, length-controlled reasoning RL and agentic RL), with thinking enabled by default in the chat template. The whole 22-layer stack runs twice (num_loops 2), and the final norm is applied after each pass. In Section 2.1, training the loop from scratch beat upcycling a standard Transformer, two passes gave the best trade-off, and a variant that shares the KV cache across passes halves it but gained less, so the release keeps a separate KV per pass. modeling_nanbeige.py stores pass k of layer i at cache index i + k × num_physical_layers; it also contains LoopSplit, mHC with depth attention, n-gram embeddings and a loop_share_kv option, all off in the released configs. The card asks for transformers==4.45.1 with trust_remote_code and points to Nanbeige forks of SGLang, vLLM, llama.cpp and Ollama; upstream support was later merged in llama.cpp (ggml-org/llama.cpp#25994), SGLang (sgl-project/sglang#32151) and vLLM through its Transformers backend (vllm-project/vllm#56071, v0.30.0), each with separate KV slots per loop. The FP8 and GPTQ-Int8 repos are quantizations of the post-trained model. Nanbeige4.2-3B-DSpark is a separate 5-layer draft model (847,946,241 parameters by safetensors count) for DSpark speculative decoding of Nanbeige4.2-3B in the forked SGLang and vLLM, so it is not listed. The safetensors count of the BF16 repos is 4,169,800,704 parameters.

models.name: OrbitLM-1.8B-Thinking
models.tokens: 1.5T (1.48T in the paper), plus 14.7B SFT and RL

passes.range: 1-4 (exit_at_step=k-1 in generate; hf_overrides total_ut_steps in vLLM)

notes.en: OrbitLM-1.8B-Thinking is a reasoning chat model for Russian and English (thinking on by default, tool calling), trained from scratch with the Qwen3 tokenizer and then given SFT for chat and GRPO RL on math and code. It uses the Ouro-1.4B layout: one stack of 24 layers (hidden size 2048, 16 heads with no grouped KV) runs four times per token with an exit gate after each pass; it has 1.86B parameters (1.23B in the shared layers, 0.62B in untied embedding and output matrices) and applies 5.24B per generated token. It is the larger run that arXiv v2 of the paper adds in Section 5.4 and Appendix K: 1.26T tokens at 4K context, then 220B at 16K and 32K, 1.48T in total, which the card's introduction gives as 1.5T; the paper's controlled 1.4B LoopLM trained on 310B tokens and its Looped Qwen conversion of Qwen3-1.7B-Base are different models with no checkpoints on ai-forever's Hugging Face account. total_ut_steps is 4 in config.json; generate(..., exit_at_step=k-1) answers from pass k, and vLLM always runs all four passes unless hf_overrides sets a lower total_ut_steps. Each pass keeps its own keys and values, 96 layer entries per token or 0.75 MiB per token in bf16, in both modelling_ouro.py and the vLLM plugin; paper Appendix K reports that reusing the last pass's cache drifted on long reasoning traces, while sharing the cache of passes 2-4 halved it with a 3.7-point drop on 300 GSM8K problems. Loading needs trust_remote_code on transformers 4.56 or later; vLLM 0.26 and older include the Ouro architecture, and newer releases need the vllm_plugin folder in the model repo (checked with vLLM 0.34). Prompts start with <|endoftext|> as in training. The card describes the RL loss as weighted over every pass by the exit gate, while paper Table 28 lists GRPO on the final iteration.
notes.zh: OrbitLM-1.8B-Thinking 是面向俄语和英语的推理对话模型（默认开启思考，支持工具调用），用 Qwen3 tokenizer 从头训练，之后做了对话 SFT 和数学、代码上的 GRPO RL。它沿用 Ouro-1.4B 的结构：一个 24 层的层栈（hidden size 2048，16 个注意力头，不用 grouped KV）对每个 token 跑四遍，每遍之后有一个 exit gate；参数量 1.86B（共享层 1.23B，不共享的 embedding 和输出矩阵 0.62B），按每遍重复计算共享层，每生成一个 token 作用 5.24B 参数。它是论文 arXiv v2 在 Section 5.4 和 Appendix K 中新增的较大规模训练：先在 4K 上下文训练 1.26T token，再在 16K 和 32K 上训练 220B，共 1.48T，模型卡开头写作 1.5T；论文中受控实验的 1.4B LoopLM（310B token）以及由 Qwen3-1.7B-Base 转换来的 Looped Qwen 是另外的模型，ai-forever 的 Hugging Face 账号上没有它们的 checkpoint。config.json 中 total_ut_steps 为 4；generate(..., exit_at_step=k-1) 用第 k 遍的输出作答，vLLM 总是跑满四遍，除非用 hf_overrides 调低 total_ut_steps。每一遍各存一份 key/value，每个 token 有 96 个层条目，bf16 下每 token 0.75 MiB，modelling_ouro.py 和 vLLM 插件都是如此；论文 Appendix K 报告复用最后一遍的 cache 会在长推理轨迹上漂移，而让第 2-4 遍共享 cache 可把 cache 减半，300 道 GSM8K 题上下降 3.7 分。加载需要 trust_remote_code 和 transformers 4.56 及以上版本；vLLM 0.26 及更早版本内置 Ouro 架构，更新的版本需要安装模型仓库里的 vllm_plugin 目录（在 vLLM 0.34 上验证过）。与训练时一样，prompt 以 <|endoftext|> 开头。模型卡说 RL 损失按 exit gate 对每一遍加权，而论文 Table 28 写的是在最后一遍上做 GRPO。

models.name: PonderingPythia

passes.range: fixed (trained with 3 pondering steps)

notes.en: PonderingPythia-1.4B and -2.8B (PonderPythia in the paper) are GPT-NeoX models with the Pythia architecture, pretrained from scratch with PonderLM on 300B Pile tokens; both model cards contain only the license, and the GitHub README serves as the release note. For every position the model runs the whole network, turns the predicted distribution into a probability-weighted sum of token embeddings, adds it to the input embeddings and runs the network again; pondering_steps 3 gives three such pondering passes plus the final pass that produces the logits. The paper describes a top-100 approximation of the weighted sum, but the released forward computes it over the full vocabulary (use_topk=False). The step count is fixed in training and inference for these models (paper Section 4.3), and the paper notes that inference cost grows roughly linearly with the number of pondering steps. modeling_gpt_neox.py calls every pass with past_key_values=None, so no KV cache is reused between tokens; with use_cache false in config.json, generation recomputes all four passes over the full prefix for each new token. config.json has no auto_map, so AutoModelForCausalLM loads the stock GPTNeoXForCausalLM and runs a single pass; pondering needs the modeling_gpt_neox.py shipped in the repos, which the GitHub code patches into transformers when --ponderinglm true is set.
notes.zh: PonderingPythia-1.4B 和 -2.8B（论文中称 PonderPythia）是 Pythia 架构的 GPT-NeoX 模型，用 PonderLM 在 300B token 的 Pile 上从头预训练；两个模型卡都只有 license 字段，发布说明在 GitHub README 中。每个位置先跑一遍完整网络，把预测分布变成按概率加权的 token 嵌入之和，加到输入嵌入上，再跑一遍网络；pondering_steps 3 表示三遍这样的 pondering 前向，再加一遍输出 logits 的最终前向。论文描述的加权和用 top-100 近似，但官方代码的 forward 在整个词表上计算（use_topk=False）。这两个模型在训练和推理时使用固定步数（论文 Section 4.3），论文也指出推理开销大致随 pondering 步数线性增长。modeling_gpt_neox.py 的每一遍都以 past_key_values=None 调用，token 之间不复用 KV cache；config.json 中 use_cache 为 false，生成时每个新 token 都要在完整前缀上重跑全部四遍。config.json 没有 auto_map，用 AutoModelForCausalLM 会加载 transformers 自带的 GPTNeoXForCausalLM，只跑一遍；pondering 需要仓库中附带的 modeling_gpt_neox.py，GitHub 代码在设置 --ponderinglm true 时把它替换进 transformers。

models.name: PonderLM-2-Pythia

passes.range: fixed (decoding runs one latent thought)

notes.en: PonderLM-2-Pythia-1.4b and -410m are GPT-NeoX models with the Pythia architecture (24 layers) pretrained with PonderLM-2 on 300B Pile tokens. For every token the model first runs a normal forward pass, then feeds that position's last hidden state back into the same network as a latent thought at the same position id, and predicts the next token from this second pass (num_latent_thoughts 1). In training, and for the prompt at inference, the latent thoughts of all positions are solved in parallel by Jacobi iterations over the interleaved token and thought sequence (num_jacobi_iterations 4 at inference; the paper samples 2 or 3 per training instance). With use_cache=True, as in the card example, the token pass and the thought pass each append a KV entry for the same position, so the cache holds two entries per token, which the paper's Appendix I describes as doubling the KV cache. The decoding branch of the released modeling_gpt_neox.py always runs exactly one latent thought, so num_latent_thoughts cannot be raised at inference; the longer thought chains in the paper come from separately trained models that are not released. Because thoughts reuse their token's position id, the 2048-token context is not shortened (paper Section 3.4). The cards load the models with AutoModelForCausalLM and trust_remote_code=True; the GitHub repo also contains LLaMA code and the PonderLM, Loop and Pause baselines, but its README lists only these two checkpoints.
notes.zh: PonderLM-2-Pythia-1.4b 和 -410m 是 Pythia 架构（24 层）的 GPT-NeoX 模型，用 PonderLM-2 在 300B token 的 Pile 上预训练。每个 token 先正常跑一遍前向，再把该位置的最后隐藏状态作为 latent thought、以相同的 position id 送回同一个网络，用第二遍的输出预测下一个 token（num_latent_thoughts 1）。训练时以及推理处理 prompt 时，所有位置的 latent thought 通过在 token 与 thought 交错序列上的 Jacobi 迭代并行求解（推理时 num_jacobi_iterations 为 4；论文训练时每个样本随机取 2 或 3）。按模型卡示例设置 use_cache=True 时，token 遍和 thought 遍会在同一位置各追加一条 KV，因此每个 token 在 cache 中占两条，论文 Appendix I 称之为 KV cache 翻倍。官方 modeling_gpt_neox.py 的解码分支总是只跑一个 latent thought，因此推理时不能调大 num_latent_thoughts；论文中更长的 thought 链来自另行训练、未发布的模型。由于 thought 复用其 token 的 position id，2048 的上下文长度不会缩短（论文 Section 3.4）。模型卡用 AutoModelForCausalLM 加 trust_remote_code=True 加载；GitHub 仓库还包含 LLaMA 代码以及 PonderLM、Loop 和 Pause 基线，但其 README 只列出这两个 checkpoint。

models.name: SenseNova-Loop-9B

passes.range: fixed (eval_count must match training); the card's study trains 1-4

notes.en: SenseNova-Loop-9B is a multimodal model that takes text and images and generates text; its modeling code builds on the Qwen3.5 multimodal classes in transformers, and config.json has a 27-layer vision encoder. The 32-layer decoder runs layers 0-3 once, the shared block of layers 4-27 twice and layers 28-31 once, giving 56 layer executions per forward pass; every four-layer group has three linear-attention layers and one full-attention layer. Inside the looped block, two-stream mHC reads from and writes to two residual streams through learned mappings, with a Sinkhorn-normalized mixing map (20 iterations); in the code the streams are formed at layer 4 and averaged after layer 27 on each pass, so the second pass takes the first pass's output. The modeling code gives each of the 56 layer executions its own cache slot, so full-attention KV and linear-attention states are stored per pass. The configs set loop_settings to start 4, end 28, counts [2] and eval_count 2, and the code rejects an eval_count that differs from counts; the card's loop-scaling study, with matched training and inference loops from 1 to 4, found 3 or 4 loops best, while both releases use 2 for inference efficiency. The card gives no training token count; it describes training on text, images, code and tool-use trajectories with context extended to 512K tokens, while the Preview card gives up to 262,144 tokens and the AWQ config.json lists max_position_embeddings 262144. Transformers loading uses trust_remote_code (the card cites a checked Preview environment with Transformers 5.18.0); vLLM and SGLang support sits in unmerged PRs (vllm-project/vllm#64832, sgl-project/sglang#47281), the GGUF files need the OpenSenseNova/llama.cpp fork, and the card also documents LightLLM. Next to the BF16 checkpoints are an AWQ 4-bit repo with optional MTP draft weights and a GGUF repo (BF16, Q8_0, Q5_K_M, Q4_K_M and a vision projector); sensenova/SenseNova-Loop-9B-DFlash2 is a separate 967M-parameter, five-layer speculative-decoding draft model and is not listed in hf.
notes.zh: SenseNova-Loop-9B 是多模态模型，输入文本和图像、输出文本；其 modeling 代码基于 transformers 中的 Qwen3.5 多模态类，config.json 中的视觉编码器为 27 层。32 层解码器先跑一遍第 0-3 层，再把共享的第 4-27 层跑两遍，最后跑一遍第 28-31 层，每次前向执行 56 次层计算；每四层一组，含三层线性注意力和一层全注意力。循环块内的双流 mHC 通过可学习映射读写两路残差流，混合矩阵经 Sinkhorn 归一化（20 次迭代）；代码中每一遍都在第 4 层展开两路流、在第 27 层之后取平均，所以第二遍以第一遍的输出为输入。modeling 代码为 56 次层计算各分配一个 cache 槽位，全注意力的 KV 和线性注意力的状态都按遍分别存储。config 中 loop_settings 为 start 4、end 28、counts [2]、eval_count 2，代码会拒绝与 counts 不一致的 eval_count；模型卡的循环 scaling 实验让训练与推理遍数一致、取 1 到 4 遍，3 或 4 遍最好，两个版本出于推理效率都默认用 2 遍。模型卡没有给训练 token 数，只说训练数据含文本、图像、代码和工具调用轨迹，上下文扩展到 512K token；Preview 模型卡写的是最长 262,144 token，AWQ 的 config.json 中 max_position_embeddings 为 262144。用 transformers 加载需要 trust_remote_code（模型卡引用的已核验 Preview 环境为 Transformers 5.18.0）；vLLM 和 SGLang 的支持还在未合入的 PR 中（vllm-project/vllm#64832、sgl-project/sglang#47281），GGUF 文件需要 OpenSenseNova/llama.cpp 的 fork，模型卡也给了 LightLLM 的部署方法。BF16 权重之外还有附可选 MTP draft 权重的 AWQ 4-bit 仓库，以及 GGUF 仓库（BF16、Q8_0、Q5_K_M、Q4_K_M 及视觉投影器）；sensenova/SenseNova-Loop-9B-DFlash2 是单独的 967M 参数、五层的投机解码 draft 模型，未列入 hf。

models.name: TaH-plus-1.7B

passes.range: max_iter cap and decider threshold; paper also tests a cap of 1

notes.en: TaH-plus-1.7B is Qwen3-1.7B-Base fine-tuned with Think-at-Hard on 100K Open-R1 Mixture-of-Thoughts samples (math, code and science). "plus" is the paper's TaH+ variant: it keeps all 28 layers and adds a LoRA adapter and an MLP iteration decider (under 3% extra parameters), while plain TaH prunes one layer to match the baseline's size and has no released checkpoint. Every token first runs the unmodified backbone; tokens whose continue probability exceeds the decider threshold (0.9) run a second full pass with LoRA enabled, fed with a top-100 softmax mix of token embeddings from the first pass's logits, and the logits of the two passes are added. Training has two stages: backbone and LoRA are trained with oracle labels that mark tokens a reference Qwen3-1.7B mispredicts, then the decider is trained with the backbone frozen. The released TaHCache keeps one KV slot per layer and iteration, and duo-causal attention lets a query at depth d attend to positions up to its own at depths up to d. The loop runs through the tah package from the GitHub repo (TaHForCausalLM, Python 3.10, transformers 4.52.4), whose TaH backend the README calls a token-by-token Python loop for research; config.json declares a plain Qwen3ForCausalLM, so AutoModelForCausalLM loads only the single-pass backbone without LoRA and decider. nics-efc/Standard-1.7B in the same collection is the single-iteration baseline trained on the same data and is not listed; nics-efc/TaH-plus-0.6B and Standard-0.6B have no model card and are not linked from the paper, the collection or the GitHub repo, so they are not listed either.

models.name: TaH2-1.7B

passes.default: up to 2, 4, 8 (max2, max4, max8; decider threshold 0.5)
passes.range: tah_max_iter overrides the cap; paper runs max8 at 4, 8 and 12

notes.en: Three post-trained versions of Qwen3-1.7B-Base that share one recipe and differ only in max_iter, the most full 28-layer passes a token may take: 2, 4 or 8 (the depth ceiling M of the paper, set at training time and read from tah_config.json). After each pass a learned iteration decider (threshold 0.5) decides per token whether to run another pass; later passes take the output of a small MLP updater that reinjects the token embedding and maps the previous final hidden state back to the input space, and the output mixes the passes' predictions by their stopping probabilities (stop_prob_mix). Backbone, updater and decider are trained jointly for three epochs on the 1.7B subset of nics-efc/TaH2-amteam-tool (math, code, science and tool-use prompts with responses regenerated by Qwen3-8B), using online labels that mark whether another pass lowers the next-token loss. Each iteration depth keeps its own KV cache, and a query at depth m attends to executed states at earlier or equal positions and depths up to m. The paper reports that M=2 gives the best accuracy-compute trade-off while M=4 and 8 reach higher peak accuracy; on AIME24-26 the mean depth is 1.23, 1.49 and 2.22 for the three models (Table 12). Inference needs the tah2 package from the GitHub repo, either TaHForCausalLM or the bundled engine adapted from mini-SGLang; the max2 card's snippet imports the older tah package, which lacks the Qwen3MLPIterDecider and input updater these checkpoints use, while the max4 and max8 cards use tah2. nics-efc/TaH2-1.7B-Standard is the single-pass baseline trained on the same data and is not listed; the paper's 4B and 8B TaH2 models are not on the Hub.
notes.zh: 三个模型都由 Qwen3-1.7B-Base 按同一配方后训练得到，区别只在 max_iter，即每个 token 最多跑几遍完整的 28 层：2、4 或 8（即论文中的深度上限 M，训练时设定，推理时从 tah_config.json 读取）。每跑完一遍，学习得到的迭代决策器（阈值 0.5）逐 token 决定是否再跑一遍；后续各遍的输入来自一个小型 MLP updater，它重新注入 token 嵌入，并把上一遍的最终隐藏状态映射回输入空间；输出按各遍的停止概率混合各遍的预测（stop_prob_mix）。主干、updater 和决策器在 nics-efc/TaH2-amteam-tool 的 1.7B 子集（数学、代码、科学和工具调用 prompt，回答由 Qwen3-8B 重新生成）上联合训练三个 epoch，在线标签标出再跑一遍能否降低 next-token loss。每个迭代深度各存一份 KV cache，深度 m 的 query 关注位置不晚于自身、深度不超过 m 的已执行状态。论文称 M=2 的准确率与计算量权衡最好，M=4 和 8 的峰值准确率更高；在 AIME24-26 上三个模型的平均深度分别为 1.23、1.49 和 2.22（Table 12）。推理需要 GitHub 仓库中的 tah2 包，可用 TaHForCausalLM 或改编自 mini-SGLang 的自带引擎；max2 的模型卡示例导入的是旧的 tah 包，它没有这些 checkpoint 所用的 Qwen3MLPIterDecider 和 input updater，max4 和 max8 的模型卡用的是 tah2。nics-efc/TaH2-1.7B-Standard 是用相同数据训练的单遍基线，未列出；论文中的 4B 和 8B TaH2 模型没有发布到 Hub。
